# Real Estate U

> > Real Estate U provides state-approved online real estate licensing courses, exam preparation, and career guidance for aspiring agents across multiple U.S. states.

Real Estate U (RealEstateU) offers comprehensive pre-licensing education, state exam prep materials, and post-licensing support for real estate professionals. The platform serves students in California, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Texas, Georgia, Wisconsin, Alabama, North Dakota, and other states with courses approved by state regulatory boards and aligned with PSI and Pearson VUE exam requirements.

## Key Topics

- Real estate licensing
- Pre-license courses
- State exam preparation
- Salesperson license requirements
- PSI and Pearson VUE exams
- Sponsoring broker selection
- California real estate license
- Pennsylvania real estate license
- Virginia real estate license
- Online real estate education
- Licensing requirements by state
- Real estate career guidance
- License renewal procedures
- New agent onboarding
- Real estate exam study strategies

## State Licensing Requirements & Courses

- [Virginia Real Estate License | 100% Online Classes | RealEstateU](https://realestateu.com/virginia-real-estate-license-online): Virginia 60-hour online real estate license course & exam prep
- [Real Estate License Pennsylvania Requirements | Real Estate U: Online Courses & License](https://realestateu.com/pennsylvania-real-estate-license-requirements): Pennsylvania license requirements, courses & PearsonVUE exam details
- [How To Become A Real Estate Agent In Wisconsin | Real Estate U: Online Courses & License](https://realestateu.com/how-to-become-a-real-estate-agent-in-wisconsin): Wisconsin licensing guide with DSPS & PearsonVUE exam steps
- [Alabama Real Estate Practice Exam | AL Real Estate Test Questions](https://realestateu.com/alabama-state-exam-prep): Alabama state exam prep with practice tests & study materials
- [North Dakota Real Estate License Course Online](https://realestateu.com/north-dakota-real-estate-license-course): North Dakota 90-hour pre-license course approved by NDREC
- [Get Your Real Estate License in San Diego | Real Estate U: Online Courses & License](https://realestateu.com/online-real-estate-courses-in-san-diego): San Diego California real estate license online courses & training
